info.title: Teeworlds-MRPG-0.6 Editor Studio Universal AI & MCP API
info.summary: Model-agnostic AI content creation, inspection, scenario analysis, semantic map & structure analysis (buildings, castles, houses, caves, terrain, zones, DB objects) with real PNG map screenshots, similar-record search, safe server-side patch_json verification, dry-run diff preview, MCP JSON-RPC 2.0, and Change Request API for game database tables, scenario JSON files, and DDNet v4 maps.
info.description: Autonomous model-agnostic AI integration platform for Teeworlds-MRPG-0.6 Editor Studio. Share a single link (/ai or /) for instant self-discovery via /.well-known/ai-plugin.json (alias api/ai.php?action=discovery), api/ai.php?action=openapi (works on every host, including those blocking static .json; /openapi.json is the same document behind rewrite rules only), /mcp, or /api/ai.php?action=manifest. Recommended read-only preflight: action=analyze (scenario corpus/file analysis) and action=similar (anti-duplicates), then verify edits with action=apply_patch before action=propose. Authenticate with a scoped Bearer AI token (Authorization: Bearer esai_<token>) or guest cookie session. Direct SQL/disk mutations are impossible; writes submit reversible Change Requests reviewed by an administrator.

BearerAuth.description: Scoped AI Bearer token issued by an administrator in Guests & AI Tokens UI. Enforces read/create/update/delete scopes and guest tab ACLs without requiring cookie CSRF.

SessionCookie.name: PHPSESSID
SessionCookie.description: PHP session cookie obtained via /api/auth.php?action=status or guest_login.

CsrfHeader.name: X-Editor-CSRF
CsrfHeader.description: 64-hex CSRF token returned by GET /api/auth.php?action=status. Required for cookie-authenticated POSTs together with matching Origin header (not required when using BearerAuth).

code.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier (e.g. auth_required, invalid_token, token_revoked, token_expired, scope_forbidden, confirmation_required, resource_forbidden, guest_forbidden, unknown_resource, unknown_field, unknown_filter_field, invalid_json, validation_failed, version_conflict, base_hash_mismatch, request_not_pending, rate_limited, method_not_allowed, unsupported_media_type, missing_origin, cross_origin_forbidden, csrf_token, payload_too_large).

version.description: Current pending request version when version_conflict occurs.

retry_after.description: Seconds until rate limit clears when rate_limited occurs.

resource.description: Allowed DB resource key from manifest.resources (excluding scenarios/maps).

id.description: Required for update/delete; omit for create/copy.

source_id.description: Required for copy: existing source DB record ID to clone.

tempId.description: Optional explicit temporary ID (2000000000..2000999999) on DB create/copy (auto-assigned sequentially if omitted).

ref.description: Optional symbolic alias on DB create/copy (e.g. "boss_sword"). Server assigns a tempId and substitutes "$boss_sword" across all subsequent operations' data and patch_json, returning resolved_refs.

data.description: Column-to-value map matching the resource schema.

patch_json.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch map keyed by JSON column name (e.g. {"Data": {"bonus": {"atk": 5}}}) preserving existing sibling keys.

expected_before.description: Optimistic concurrency expectation: map of column names to expected current values in DB; mismatches abort with 409 version_conflict.

baseHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest from get&resource=scenarios to reject stale updates (409 base_hash_mismatch).

patch_json.description: RFC 7396 merge patch applied cleanly over the existing scenario JSON content without wiping untouched sections.

nickname.description: Optional author label; defaults to the guest account display name/login.

message.description: Clear explanation of the proposed fix or addition for the reviewing administrator.

confirm_dangerous.description: Required true when submitting deletes, clearing non-empty JSON, batches >10 ops, or editing worlds/dungeons/vouchers.

idempotency_key.description: Optional deduplication key so retrying the same HTTP submission never creates duplicate pending requests.

request_id.description: Set when revising an existing pending change request owned by the caller.

version.description: Required optimistic lock version matching the pending request when request_id is set.

truncated.description: True when rows were capped early to respect max_bytes.

ApplyPatchRequest.description: Verify-before-propose: read-only server-side RFC 7396 merge of patch_json against the live record/file. Returns before/after/diff/noop plus the same errors action=propose would emit. Writes nothing and does not consume cooldown.

resource.description: Database resource key (items, quests, bots_npc, quest_bots, worlds, ...) or 'scenarios'.

id.description: Record primary key for DB resources (integer); scenario filename may also be passed here as a string.

filename.description: Scenario filename when resource=scenarios (alias of id).

patch_json.description: RFC 7396 merge patch. For DB resources: an object keyed by JSON column names, e.g. {"Data": {"bonus": {"strength": 8}}}. For scenarios: a plain object merged into the file content, e.g. {"scenario_mode": "universal"}.

data.description: Optional explicit field values forming the base the patch is applied on (same semantics as an update operation field data).

baseHash.description: scenarios only: SHA-256 of the current file content; mismatch fails with 409 base_hash_mismatch.

expected_before.description: DB resources only: map of column → expected current value; mismatch fails with 409 version_conflict.

text.description: Reply text to append to the Change Request discussion thread (alias: message).

id.description: Owned pending Change Request ID to withdraw.

get.summary: Discover OpenAPI/manifest schemas or inspect DB tables, scenarios, lookups, maps (including semantic building/structure recognition and PNG map screenshots), references, similar records, and scenario/map analysis

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to perform. llms_txt: public Markdown quickstart. search: cross-resource search across all accessible tables/scenarios/maps. context: 360-degree entity neighborhood (record + outbound/inbound relations + scenario links). request: inspect a Change Request with review discussion messages. analyze: scenario corpus/file analysis or deep semantic map analysis. map_screenshot: visual/hybrid/schematic PNG screenshot. similar: anti-duplicate search.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: For action=get on DB resources: comma-separated list of up to 50 integer IDs for batch retrieval (e.g. 10,20,30).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: For action=list on DB resources: column name or -column for descending sort (e.g. -ID, Name, -Price).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: For action=search: search query string (alias: search).

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: For action=search: optional comma-separated subset of resource keys to scan.

parameters.name: per_resource_limit
parameters.description: For action=search: max hits returned per resource.

parameters.name: max_relations
parameters.description: For action=context: max related rows returned per relation bucket.

parameters.name: include_messages
parameters.description: For action=request: include review discussion messages (default 1).

parameters.name: include_schemas
parameters.description: For action=manifest: set 0 for a compact summary without per-resource column schemas.

parameters.name: include_examples
parameters.description: For action=resources: include realistic create/patch_json/copy examples.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Target resource key (e.g. items, quests, quest_bots, scenarios, maps, or lookup name).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Integer primary key for DB/lookup/world records; scenario filename for action=get|references|analyze&resource=scenarios (alias: file).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Alias for id when resource=scenarios.

parameters.name: world
parameters.description: World ID when resource=maps.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative .map path under data/maps/ or maps/ when resource=maps.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text search.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON object mapping allowed column names to exact scalar, null, or IN-array values (e.g. {"Type":"Quest"}).

parameters.name: filter_key
parameters.description: Alternative single-column filter name.

parameters.name: filter_value
parameters.description: Exact value for filter_key.

parameters.name: filter_values
parameters.description: Comma-separated IN-list for filter_key.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of allowed columns to project on DB list/get (PK is always included).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: For action=similar: proposed label to match against existing records (case-insensitive, accent/ё/punct-insensitive Dice bigram scoring).

parameters.name: decode
parameters.description: Decode DB JSON text columns automatically into JSON values.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: Response JSON byte budget for paginated lists (sets truncated=true when reached).

parameters.name: summary_only
parameters.description: For get&resource=scenarios: omit raw content JSON and return summary + hash + metadata only.

parameters.name: include_references
parameters.description: For get: include outbound and inbound references permitted for caller.

parameters.name: include_entities
parameters.description: For get&resource=maps: include extracted entity/switch coordinates.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: For get|analyze|map_screenshot on maps: world pixel X coordinate for rich point context (enclosure, visual layers, inside_structure, nearest_standable_point) or region center.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: For get|analyze|map_screenshot on maps: world pixel Y coordinate for rich point context or region center.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: For analyze&resource=maps or map_screenshot: viewport focus (overview, spawn, guild_house:<id>, house:<id>, zone:<num|name>, structure:<id>, warehouse:<id>, aether:<id>, or partial name).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: hybrid (real visual tilesets + structure/house/castle overlays & labels), visual (clean in-game view), or schematic (collision/interior/terrain blueprint).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: json returns base64 PNG + coordinate mapping & visible structures; png streams raw image/png bytes.

parameters.name: structure_kind
parameters.description: For analyze&resource=maps: optional filter for structures.items by recognized structure kind.

parameters.name: include_minimap
parameters.description: For maps get/analyze: include semantic ASCII minimap in region_analysis.

parameters.name: compact
parameters.description: For analyze&resource=maps: trim per-layer and structure lists for compact token usage.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: target PNG width in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: maximum PNG height in pixels.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: For analyze&resource=maps or map_screenshot with x/y: pixel radius around point.

parameters.name: radius_tiles
parameters.description: For analyze&resource=maps or map_screenshot with x/y: tile radius around point.

parameters.name: pad_tiles
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: extra padding tiles around targeted structure/zone.

parameters.name: show_grid
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: draw tile/pixel coordinate ruler and status bar.

parameters.name: show_structures
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: overlay recognized structure bounding boxes.

parameters.name: show_labels
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: draw labels for structures, spawns, and objects.

parameters.name: show_objects
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: draw spawn and correlated DB world object markers.

parameters.name: show_collision
parameters.description: For map_screenshot: overlay game/front collision tiles (solid, unhookable, death, water, house/service tiles).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: For action=references: lookup dictionary name (items, quests, quest_boards, worlds, skills, bots, attributes).

200.description: Success payload (shape depends on action: manifest/openapi/spec, paginated list, get record, references graph, analyze scenario/map report, map_screenshot JSON or raw PNG, similar candidates).

analyzeCorpus.summary: analyze: corpus overview of all scenarios (component histogram + missing dependencies)

analyzeScenario.summary: analyze: single scenario breakdown with dependencies and reuse

similarFound.summary: similar: anti-duplicate candidates before creating an item

400.description: Invalid parameters, unknown field/filter, or invalid ID

403.description: Resource or lookup not enabled for caller

404.description: Unknown resource or record/scenario not found

get.description: action=analyze&resource=scenarios[&id=file.json|search=...] — read-only scenario analysis: corpus overview (component histogram, invalid files, missing_references/dependencies) without id, or a single file breakdown (components with known/legacy/unknown status, resolved references, inbound links, reuse candidates, baseHash for propose). action=similar&resource=<res>&name=<Name>[&limit=5] — anti-duplicate search across any named DB table or lookup; resources without a label column return empty candidates. All other actions behave as before: discovery/openapi (public), manifest/resources/list/get/references/history (auth).

post.summary: Validate operations, preview diffs/conflicts, verify patch_json server-side, or propose/revise a guest change request

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: validate: check operations (read-only, resolves symbolic ref/$alias). preview: dry-run analysis with diff (read-only). apply_patch: read-only server-side verify of patch_json. propose: submit/revise a Change Request. request_reply: post a comment to an owned CR discussion thread. request_withdraw: withdraw an owned pending Change Request.

validateMultiOp.summary: Validate creating an item with tempId and referencing it from a scenario

proposeCreate.summary: Submit a guest change request with idempotency_key

value.message: Add Rune Key quest item and starter scenario

proposeRevise.summary: Revise an existing pending change request with optimistic version lock

value.message: Fixed typo in item description per admin feedback

applyPatchVerify.summary: Read-only verify of a scenario patch_json before proposing (no writes)

200.description: Success: validate/preview/apply_patch analysis, or the created/revised Change Request (propose).

request.message: Add Rune Key quest item and starter scenario

applyPatchScenario.summary: apply_patch: read-only server-side verify of a scenario patch (no writes)

applyPatchRecord.summary: apply_patch: DB record merge with per-column diff (no writes)

400.description: Structured validation failure or malformed payload

errors.message: Несовместимые взаимоисключающие флаги квеста: Tutorial, Type main.

403.description: Forbidden resource, guest_forbidden (admin calling propose), CSRF, or Origin error

409.description: Version conflict, stale scenario baseHash, missing record, or non-pending status

429.description: Cooldown or preview/submit rate limit exceeded

post.description: action=apply_patch — read-only server-side verify of patch_json: the server RFC 7396-merges the patch onto the live record/file and returns before/after/diff/noop plus exactly the errors action=propose would emit (e.g. missing_reference, base_hash_mismatch 409, version_conflict 409). Writes nothing, consumes no cooldown. Recommended order: analyze/similar -> get -> apply_patch -> validate -> preview -> propose. validate/preview remain available as-is; propose creates or revises a guest Change Request (admin-approved).
